SENDMAIL.description: Path to the sendmail-compatible binary used to dispatch emails.

REPORTMAIL.description: Primary email address to receive logcheck summary reports.

TEMPDIR.description: Directory for temporary files (e.g., intermediate log processing).

WORKDIR.description: Base directory for logcheck configuration, rule sets, and state files.

LOGFILE.description: Path to the logcheck log file (used if not using logrotate).

LINES.description: Number of lines to read from each monitored log file per processing cycle.

TIMEOUT.description: Maximum number of seconds logcheck waits before timing out on log processing tasks.

COMPRESS_LOGS.description: Whether to automatically compress rotated log files before analysis (e.g., via gzip).

SEND_EMPTY_RESULTS.description: Whether to send email reports even if no suspicious lines were found.

SERVER_MODE.description: Run in continuous server mode, polling logs at regular intervals (requires daemonization support).

LOGFILES.description: List of specific log files to monitor.

path.description: Absolute path to the log file (e.g., /var/log/auth.log).

flags.description: Optional flags for this log file (e.g., 'follow', 'tail').

REPORT_HOSTS.description: List of hostnames to prefix in the subject line (e.g., 'prod-web1').

CUSTOM_RULES.description: List of custom ignore/line rules (regex patterns).

name.description: Human-readable name of the rule (for documentation).

mode.description: Whether to 'ignore' lines matching the pattern or treat as 'violation'.

pattern.description: Perl-compatible regular expression to match log lines.

LOG_DIRS.description: List of log directories to scan recursively.

REPORT_CC.description: Additional email addresses to CC on logcheck reports.

VIOLATION_RULESETS.description: Name(s) of rulesets to flag as violations (e.g., 'failures', 'violations').
